snippet.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Yuggidrasil - Release Trailer (GBA ROM Hack)
snippet.description:
Remember when Yu-Gi-Oh! was simple? Same 2002 duels, endless new ways to play.

Yuggidrasil is a free fan rom hack of Yu-Gi-Oh! The Eternal Duelist Soul (GBA), together with the EDS Card Randomizer.

YUGGIDRASIL (rom hack)
• 36 house rules to mix and match: Life Points, Draw Phase, Tributes, Orichalcos front row, Destiny Draw, Alignments, Kinship, Star Perks and more
• The CPU plays by your rules too
• New style and music!
• New Campaign!
• Turbo mode on by default

EDS CARD RANDOMIZER (runs in your browser)
• Randomize starter decks, booster packs, opponents' decks and the Forbidden/Limited list
• Hybrid monsters spliced from real cards
• Monsters can borrow Spell and Trap effects, and even carry a second effect
• Every seed is a new game. Share seeds to race or compare
• Works on the original game and on Yuggidrasil
• Your ROM never leaves your computer: nothing is uploaded

HOW TO PLAY
You need your own copy of Yu-Gi-Oh! The Eternal Duelist Soul (USA).
Apply the Yuggidrasil patch with Rom Patcher JS
Then patch Yuggidrasil via the Card Randomizer and you're set!

LINKS

Rom Hacking (dot) Net
community (dot) romhackplaza (dot) org

CREDITS
Built on the eds-decomp decompilation project.
Music: original made for this trailer.
